LESSON: RAMAYAN AND SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures
Topic 4.1: Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how to 2. How do we handle the source of divine knowledge handle and open the Scriptures with scriptures?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya
3. practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps
4. apply Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: RAMAYAN AND SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: RAMAYAN AND SRI GURU GRANTH SAHIB JI
Study Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to 2. How do we handle the source of divine knowledge handle and open the Scriptures with scriptures?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
